node.to: 這個是我們做好的露營地了，因為島上可能已經沒有安全的地方了.

node.id: The fuel cell signal is somewhere nearby!
node.to: 燃料電池信號就在附近!

node.id: It is coming from under the water!
It seems that workers at the dam lived at the [LOCATION=FROST_HORN_TOWN_2]. Perhaps the key is with them.
node.to: 大壩的工人住在 [LOCATION=FROST_HORN_TOWN_2]. 也許他們那邊有鑰匙

node.id: The [LOCATION=FROST_HORN_TOWN_2] should be North of my position.
We have been trying to get vital cargo to the [LOCATION=FROST_HORN_ARCTIC_BASE] but our vehicles keep getting stuck in the mud.
node.to: 我們嘗試將重要貨物帶到[LOCATION=FROST_HORN_ARCTIC_BASE] 但是我們的車陷在泥裡.

node.id: What could the cargo be? Something to stop this apocalypse we are living in?
node.to: 貨物可能是什麼？阻止我們所生活的世界末日的東西?

node.id: So let me get this straight: We have no food, but 5 years worth of Snort Cola? Who planned this? Steve?
node.to: 讓我直截了當地說：我們沒有食物，但是有5年的Snort可樂？這是誰策劃的？史提夫？

node.id: The [ORANGE]Undercrown[WHITE] east entrance is now open.
node.to: T[ORANGE]皇冠之下[WHITE] 的東門現已開放.

node.id: Hold down [BUTTON=ROTATE_CAMERA] and drag to control the camera.
node.to: 按住 [BUTTON=ROTATE_CAMERA] 拖動來控制視角.

node.id: Now I'll just check everything is operational.
node.to: 現在我來檢查一下看看一切是否正常.

node.id: I need to find my way to the [EMOJI=crown] Crown Station.
node.to: 我需要找到去 [EMOJI=crown]皇冠車站的路.

node.id: Spooky. The food must be out of this world!
node.to: 太詭異了， 世界上最好的就是食物!

node.id: "A word of warning. Be wary of extremely hot local temperatures. Military activity in the area is also at heightened state. Southern parts inaccessible."
node.to: "注意當地的酷熱溫度。該地區的軍事活動也處於緊張狀態。無法進入南部地區."

node.id: "Some people requested more salad recipes in the food menu. The Chef added Steakhouse Salad as a compromise."
node.to: "有些人要求在食物菜單上增加沙拉食譜。廚師添加了牛排沙拉作為折衷方案."

node.id: "ATC Report: Severe atmospheric disturbances detected. All planes grounded until further notice."
node.to: "檢測報告：檢測到嚴重的大氣干擾。所有飛機停飛，另行通知."

node.id: "The Fabricator we sent to [LOCATION=POLARIS_FACILITY] is having some data corruption issues. Clearly needs simpler instructions."
node.to: "送到[LOCATION=POLARIS_FACILITY]的機器存在一些資料損壞問題。顯然需要更簡單的說明"

node.id: "The patient has both frostbites and thermal burns."
"All high security traffic must use the [ORANGE]Crown Station Access Elevators[WHITE] only."
node.to: "進入[ORANGE]皇冠車站入口電梯[WHITE]必須要高度安全."

node.id: It looks like the access elevator should be nearby.
node.to: 看起來電梯入口應該在附近.

node.id: [EMOJI=up arrow] Undercrown Shelters\n[EMOJI=building construction] Loading Areas\n[EMOJI=crown] Crown Station Access
node.to: [EMOJI=up arrow] 皇冠之下庇護所\n[EMOJI=building construction]裝貨區\n[EMOJI=crown] 皇冠車站通道

node.id: This requires a lot of materials. But there's no hurry I guess.
node.to: 這需要很多材料。但我想不必著急.

node.id: That's a lot of eggs. But I guess I can deposit the ones I don't need here.
node.to: 有很多雞蛋。但是我想我可以把我不需要的存到這裡.

node.id: The old monsters who attacked the base are now dead. However, the rift is still active and its effects are affecting the world around it.
node.to: 攻擊基地的怪物現在已經死了。然而，裂谷仍然活躍，並且影響周圍的世界.

node.id: There is a dropped notebook page on ground: One of the guests is reportedly acting suspiciously. Keeps carrying valuable looking items. Maybe contraband. \n[GREEN]Motel's Office[WHITE] should have the guest and room info.
node.to: 地上掉了一頁筆記本紙: 據報導其中一位元客人的行為可疑。隨身攜帶貴重物品。也許是違禁品. \n[GREEN]汽車旅館的辦公室[WHITE] 應該有客人和房間的資訊.

node.id: The final fuel cell resides in the artificial lake created by the dam. You need to drain it.
node.to: 最後一個燃料電池位於大壩形成的人工湖中。你需要把它排幹.

node.id: A thundering boom gives way to quiet sounds of dripping. The Artificial lake has been emptied.
node.to: 雷鳴般的隆隆聲過後。人工湖已排幹.

node.id: There is a strange doorway in the middle of the military base. What could be inside?
node.to: 在軍事基地的中間有一個奇怪的門。裡面可能有什麼?

node.id: The road leading deeper into the structure is ruined. Find an alternate route.
node.to: 通往建築物更深處的道路被毀了。找到另一條路線。

node.id: The elevator ahead should take you up to the Crown Station.
node.to: 前面的電梯會把你送到皇冠車站.
水電站大壩控制室鑰匙

node.id: The rise of civilization was sparked by the invention of agriculture.
node.to: 文明的興起是由農業的發明.
不要吃掉它， 把它存起來.

node.id: We scoured the earth of materials. We built homes. Towns.
node.to: 我們搜遍了各種材料。我們建設我們的家園.

node.id: The samples in this collection are building blocks of our civilization.
node.to: 這些樣品是我們文明的基石.

node.id: Deposit them, so the next generation has a chance.
node.to: 把它們存起來，這樣下一代就有機會了.

node.id: The samples in this collection will ensure our safety in the coming age.
node.to: 收集樣品將確保我們未來的安全.

node.id: Deposit them for the continued survival of mankind.
node.to: 為了人類的生存而保存它們.

node.id: We lived a simple and blissful life, enjoying the bounties of the earth.
node.to: 我們過著簡單而幸福的生活，享受著地球的富饒.

node.id: The samples in this collection are all found in nature.
node.to: 這些收集的樣品都是在自然界中發現的.

node.id: Gather and deposit them here with care and respect.
node.to: 小心地把它們收集起來並存放在這裡.

node.id: We slowly evolved. We started to understand that we were something more than just a part of nature.
node.to: 我們慢慢進化。我們開始明白我們不僅僅是大自然的一部分.

node.id: By creating the first primitive tools and clothes, we set ourselves apart.
node.to: 通過製作出第一批原始的工具和衣服，我們使自己與眾不同.

node.id: The samples in this collection are the ingredients of the dawn of humanity.
node.to: 收集的樣本是人類曙光.

node.id: Now kindly deposit the materials for the future of mankind.
node.to: 現在請為人類的未來儲存材料.

node.id: The samples in this collection are the stepping stones on the path to beyond.
node.to: 本系列中的樣本是通往超越之路的踏腳石.

node.id: Lay down the samples so we can continue from where we left off.
node.to: 放下樣品，這樣我們就可以從我們停止的地方繼續.

node.id: The Ark is almost complete. Please carry on the good work.
node.to: 方舟幾乎完工了。請繼續做好這項工作.

node.id: I want to remind all our Volunteers that there will be an afterparty.
node.to: 我想提醒我們所有的志願者，排隊馬上開始.

node.id: It will be held at Level 2 when the Ark is complete.
node.to: 當方舟完成後，它將在第二層舉行.

node.id: Locked! I need to find out how to open this door. Maybe there are clues nearby?
node.to: 鎖上了！我需要知道如何打開這扇門。也許附近有線索?

node.id: Finally here! Now to find that key!
node.to: 終於到了！現在找到那把鑰匙!

node.id: This does not look very accessible either. [EMOJI=neutral face]
There's another [GREEN]doorway[WHITE] in the room. It looks like I have to find [GREEN]a detour[WHITE]. [EMOJI=grimacing face]
node.to: 房間裡還有另外 [GREEN]一扇門[WHITE] . 好像有另外一個 [GREEN]小道[WHITE]. [EMOJI=grimacing face]

node.id: The Ark is now [NUMBER] percent complete.
node.to: 方舟現在已經完成百分之[NUMBER] 完成.

node.id: Upgrade Sleeping Bag to sleep longer.
node.to: 升級睡袋可以延長睡眠時間.

node.id: Not enough [GREEN]XP[WHITE] (Experience Points). Spending points would lower your [GREEN]Experience Level[WHITE], which is not allowed.
node.to: 缺少 [GREEN]經驗[WHITE] (經驗點). 消耗經驗點，將會降低[GREEN]經驗等級[WHITE], 禁止這樣操作.

node.id: Maximum number of hours to sleep [AMOUNT]

Unfortunately The Island Military is not interested in your Helmet designs. While quite effective in harsh weather, it does not provide enough protection against other forces. Our testers did like the classic look of the helmet very much though.
node.to: 不幸的是，島上的軍方對你設計的頭盔不感興趣。雖然在惡劣天氣下非常有效，但它不能抵禦其他的外部力量。但是我們的測試人員非常喜歡頭盔的經典外觀.

node.id: The sample helmet is held at the Military Road Checkpoint and you can get it back from there.
node.to: 頭盔樣品放在軍用路的保存點，你可以從那裡取回。

node.id: The structure has become increasingly active for as yet unknown reasons. It is affecting the flow time around it and is also causing some local spatial anomalies.
node.to: 由於某些未知的原因，結構變得越來越不穩定。它影響了周圍時間的流動，也造成了一些局部空間異常.

node.id: The Digital Watch we invented mitigates some of the effects. It should allow us to interact with the event horizon inside.
node.to: 我們發明的數位手錶，減少一些影響。有了它，我們可以與內部的視界互動.

node.id: The situation outside has gone from bad to worse in a matter of weeks. Every day I need to fend off not only the ex-humans, but also people seeking shelter. Meanwhile my employers are only concerned about hiding their wealth in the ground. I managed to photograph one of them kneeling next to a rock in the garden. I've marked the spot so it should be easy to investigate further later on.
node.to: 外面的局勢在幾周內變得越來越糟糕。每天我不僅要趕走怪物，還要趕走那些尋求庇護的人。與此同時，我的雇主只專注于把他們的財富藏在地下。我設法拍下了其中一個跪在花園岩石旁的照片。我已經標記了該點，以便以後進一步調查.

node.id: I dropped in the weekly shipment as usual. It looks like the food shortage is getting worse and some items aren't available anymore. It's all in the shipping list.
node.to: 我像往常一樣順道送來了每週的貨。看起來食物短缺的情況越來越嚴重，有些東西已經賣不出去了。都在發貨單上.

node.id: There's also another delivery truck with some 'train parts' stuck at the nearby road. There's lockdowns and roadblocks everywhere, and the driver guy said that the truck needs to stay here for a while until everything clears up. I hope it happens soon.
node.to: 在附近的公路上還有另一輛載有“火車零件”的運貨卡車。到處都是封鎖和路障，司機說卡車需要在這裡停留一段時間，直到一切都清理乾淨。我希望儘快清理好

node.id: Our unit was supposed to provide escort for a convoy with important cargo passing through Pimaville.
node.to: 我們的部隊本應為一個護送車隊護送一批重要貨物通過皮馬維爾.

node.id: The problem is that the convoy is already half a day late. Just got confirmation that they haven't reached checkpoint C either. We are not equipped to venture out into that desert to look for them.
node.to: 問題是車隊已經晚了半天。剛剛確認他們也沒有到達C檢查站。我們也沒有裝備不能去沙漠尋找他們.

node.id: It seems we just have to wait.
The employees at the train station just called and said that they had been delivered the wrong package.
node.to: 火車站的員工剛剛打電話說他們收到了一個錯的包裹.

node.id: After some internal investigation we have concluded that there was a mislabeling incident and their package could be in\nany one of these three locations that we delivered cargo to yesterday.
node.to: 經過一些內部調查，我們得知，這次貨物發錯的原因標籤貼錯了\n 他們的包裹可能在我們昨天交付貨物的這三個地點中的任何一個.

node.id: Look for an alternate route to the [ORANGE]Launchpad[WHITE].
node.to: 尋找另一條路線去 [ORANGE]發射台[WHITE].

node.id: Look around for clues where the key could be.
Listen to the Founder's Mansion [ORANGE]Audio Log[WHITE].
node.to: 聽聽創始人官邸 [ORANGE]音訊日誌[WHITE].

node.id: Listen to the Founder's Office [ORANGE]Audio Log[WHITE].
node.to: 聽創始人辦公室的 [ORANGE]音訊日誌[WHITE].

node.id: Go to the Escape Pod Launchpad.
Find a way to open [ORANGE]The Fortress[WHITE] gate.
node.to: 找到打開 [ORANGE]堡壘[WHITE] 大門方法.

node.id: [GREEN]Search[WHITE] for the [ORANGE]Launchpad Key[WHITE] in The Fortress.
node.to: 在堡壘處[GREEN]搜尋[WHITE] [ORANGE]發射台的鑰匙[WHITE].
在 [ORANGE]發射台處[WHITE]找到 [ORANGE]逃生艙[WHITE].

node.id: Get past the Volcanic Passage Gate.
Reach the [LOCATION=CALDERA] at the top of the mountain.
A hardened helmet that is a staple of workplace safety in the construction business.
node.to: 一種硬化頭盔，是建築業工作場所安全的主要佩戴工具.

node.id: The shelter is now ready to be entered.
node.to: 現在可以進入避難所了.

node.id: I think it's safe to enter that shelter now.
node.to: 我想現在進入那個避難所是安全的.

node.id: This is a transcript of an interrogation
The [MATERIAL_ICON=FUEL_CELL] Fuel Cell is inside that automaton [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: [MATERIAL_ICON=FUEL_CELL] 燃料電池就在那個自動機裡面 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: Rough ground here. It really took some effort to finally find something!
node.to: 這裡地面崎嶇。終於找到了一些東西，真的花了不少功夫!

node.id: There are a lot of transcriptions about phone calls between random people on this wall.
node.to: 牆上有很多關於人和人之間通話的文字記錄.

node.id: Replace the tape for machine four. Those old ladies at Central have been gossiping on the phone non stop.
node.to: 更換4號機器的磁帶。那些老太太一直在電話裡不停地閒聊.

node.id: Stowaways are getting sneakier. We found one inside a Snort machine last week!
node.to: 偷渡者越來越鬼鬼祟祟了。上周我們在蒸汽機器裡發現了一個!

node.id: Keep loading dock clear when not in use.
node.to: 不使用時，保持裝貨碼頭暢通.

node.id: How did this end up here?
Synth testing. This is an automated recording sent from The Crown Station K23.
node.to: 合成測試。這是從皇冠電臺K23發送的自動記錄。

node.id: Work in progress version of the radio voice. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 正在進行的語音廣播。 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: The Escape Pod should not be far. I should look around.
node.to: 逃生艙應該就在附近。我應該四處看看.

node.id: Finally at the top of the mountain!
I see something at the center of the caldera.
node.to: 我看到火山口中央有東西.

node.id: " Probably went hiding in his [ORANGE]Fortress[WHITE]. We can't do anything without the key."
node.to: " 可能躲進[ORANGE]堡壘[WHITE]。沒有鑰匙我們什麼都做不了."

node.id: "He locked the door and took [ORANGE]The Launchpad Key[WHITE]."
node.to: "他鎖上門，拿走了[ORANGE]啟動板鑰匙[WHITE]."

node.id: This looks like the place. But how to get in? [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 看起就是這個地方。但是怎麼進去呢？ [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: The gate cannot be [GREEN]opened[WHITE] until nearby threats are removed.
node.to: 大門無法 [GREEN]打開[WHITE]除非附近沒有任何危險.

node.id: The trail seems to be going up. I wonder what is at the top of this mountain..
node.to: 這條路似乎越走越長了。我想知道這座山頂上是什麼..

node.id: I could try scanning for [MATERIAL_ICON=FUEL_CELL] [GREEN]Fuel Cells[WHITE] using that [GREEN]Link Tower[WHITE] [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 我可以使用[GREEN]連塔[WHITE]掃描搜索 [MATERIAL_ICON=FUEL_CELL] [GREEN]燃料電池[WHITE] [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: The large rift seems to have taken me to some unknown place.
node.to: 大裂谷似乎把我帶到了一個未知的地方.

node.id: I should gather my bearings and start exploring.
[RED]NO[WHITE] Sanctuary for all of those who arrive!
node.to: [RED]沒有[WHITE]足夠的避難給所有的到達者的!

node.id: I had pictures of this place on the shelter wall.
node.to: 我在避難所的牆上的照片有看到過這個地方.

node.id: Used to come here from time to time to spend some time away from it all.
node.to: 過去經常來這裡，花些時間遠離這一切.

node.id: I guess I should just try and remove it...
node.to: 我想我應該試著把它去掉...

node.id: There are several audio logs recorded by the king at the Crown Station. Listen to all of them.
node.to: 國王在皇冠車站錄製了幾段錄音記錄。聽聽看.

node.id: This provides some insight into the life of the king.
node.to: 這使人們對國王的生活有了一些瞭解.

node.id: The Crown Station is a big place. Look for the route to the Escape Pod Launch Pad.
node.to: 皇冠車站是個大地方。尋找逃生艙發射台的路線.

node.id: The Escape Pod is again in your reach. Prepare for the journey.
node.to: 又到了逃生艙。準備旅行.

node.id: The loud sounds from the speaker attracts the monsters out from the [ORANGE]old shelter[WHITE] nearby. Build defenses to prepare for the horde. Kill all the monsters before they reach the loudspeaker.
node.to: 揚聲器發出的巨響把怪物從 [ORANGE]老庇護所[WHITE]吸引了出來. 建立防禦工事，在怪物到達揚聲器前殺死他們.

node.id: The old underground shelters are good sources of rare materials.
node.to: 古老的地下掩體有很多稀有材料.

node.id: You have been transported into an unknown area. Is there some specific purpose to all this?
node.to: 你被轉移到一個未知的地區。這一切有什麼特別的目的嗎?

node.id: You feel the searing heat of the volcano around you but your eyes are fixed on the prize - another tomb.
node.to: 你能感受到火山的灼熱，但你的眼睛卻盯著——另一座墳墓.

node.id: By refining the hardest of materials, we were able to touch the sky itself.
node.to: 通過提煉最堅硬的材料，我們能夠飛向天空.

node.id: Towers of steel and glass, larger by themselves than some cities of old.
node.to: 鋼塔和玻璃塔，比一些古老的城市還要大.

node.id: Unlike the alchemists of old, we now have the power to transmute matter into exotic materials.
node.to: 與古代煉金術士不同的是，我們現在必須將物質轉化為奇異物質的能力.

node.id: Lay down the samples, so that after the end, we can continue from where we left off.
node.to: 存好樣品，這樣一切結束後，我們還可以從我們停止的地方繼續.

node.id: Please move forward to the final area.
Follow the clue and find the key at [LOCATION=GRAVEYARD_1].
node.to: 在 [LOCATION=GRAVEYARD_1]地方， 沿著線索 找到鑰匙.

node.id: Open the gate leading to the back of the [LOCATION=GRAVEYARD_1].
Travel to [ORANGE]Fincher's Auto Salvage[WHITE], north of [LOCATION=TOWN_17].
node.to: 移動到 [ORANGE]芬奇自動打撈點[WHITE], 在[LOCATION=TOWN_17]北面.
找到一個 [ORANGE]橙色[WHITE] 墓碑 [ORANGE]在 [LOCATION=TOWN_14]的西面.

node.id: Find a |#ffce77|Yellow[WHITE] Grandfather Clock far [ORANGE]Northwest[ORANGE] of [LOCATION=TOWN_14].
node.to: 在 [LOCATION=TOWN_14] 的西北面， 找到一個 |#ffce77|黃色[WHITE] 祖父鬧鐘 .

node.id: Find any [GREEN]link tower[WHITE] to scan for [GREEN]unnatural energy[WHITE] signatures.
node.to: 找到一個 [GREEN]鏈塔[WHITE] 來掃描[GREEN]非自然能量[WHITE] 物質.

node.id: Travel to the place with [GREEN]unnatural energy[WHITE] signatures.
node.to: 用[GREEN]非自然能量[WHITE] 物質 移動到該地方.

node.id: Light the [ORANGE]Campfire Near Vulcan Ancient Ruins[ORANGE].
node.to: 點亮 [ORANGE]瓦肯古城遺址附近的營火

node.id: Military uniform of unknown origin. Excellent for combat situations.
node.to: 來歷不明的軍服。非常適合戰鬥.

node.id: Used to bind up wounds, but takes a long time to apply.
node.to: 用於包紮傷口，但使用花費時間較長.

node.id: Throwable explosive that disperses shrapnel on detonation. Not very effective against structures.
node.to: 可燃炸藥，爆炸時分散彈片。對建築物不是很有效。

node.id: Instantly transports all carried materials to the [ORANGE]Camp Storage Box[WHITE].
node.to: 立即將所有的材料運輸到[ORANGE]營地儲存箱[WHITE].

node.id: The lure emits a burst of sound waves on a frequency that attracts ex-humans.
node.to: 這種誘餌發出的一系列聲波吸引怪物。

node.id: Offers quick relief for minor pain and soreness.
node.to: 快速緩解輕微疼痛和酸痛.

node.id: An explosive that triggers when an enemy moves near it.
node.to: 當敵人靠近它時觸發炸藥.

node.id: A trio of perfectly balanced blades thrown out in a cone formation.
node.to: 三個完美平衡的葉片以圓錐形排列.

node.id: A perfectly balanced blade designed to be thrown at hostile targets.
node.to: 一把完美設計的刀，用於投擲敵對目標.

node.id: Powerful sickle-shaped sword wielded by the ancient tomb guards. Forged from mana infused metals.
node.to: 古墓守衛使用的強大鐮刀劍。由注入法力的金屬鍛造而成.

node.id: A small cube with black dots corresponding to different numerical values on its sides.
node.to: 邊上有黑點的小立方體，對應於不同的數值.

node.id: A left hind leg of an elusive animal.
node.to: 一種難以捉摸動物的左後腿.
一種異常反光的金屬碎片.

node.id: Has the power to attract materials from farther away.
node.to: 具有從遠處吸引材料的能力.

node.id: Fine tuned clock that marks the passing of time. The mechanism seems flawless, but actually runs slow.
node.to: 標記時間流逝的時鐘。這一時鐘似乎完美無缺，但實際上運行緩慢.

node.id: Piece of equipment custom made for catching fish quicker.
node.to: 為更快捕魚而定制的設備.

node.id: Tight wrappings that support the hand and the wrist during strenuous exercise.
node.to: 在劇烈運動中 防護手和手腕的裝備。

node.id: Advanced and extremely formidable metal alloy.
node.to: 先進而強大的金屬合金.

node.id: An extremely rare material used to give instructions to electronic interfaces.
node.to: 一種極為罕見的材料，用於向電子介面發出指令.

node.id: A Flower found in tropical areas.
Edible mushroom found in temperate climates.
node.to: 溫帶氣候中的食用蘑菇.

node.id: Edible mushroom found in damp places.
Rare edible mushroom that grows in cold climates.
node.to: 生長在寒冷氣候中的稀有食用蘑菇.

node.id: This evolved ranged enemy wreaks havok by thowing explosive material to its targets
node.to: 一種變異的遠端敵人 通過向其目標投擲爆炸物來進攻

node.id: I think that's it. I can now resume the flight preparations. [EMOJI=rocket]
node.to: 我想就這樣了。我現在可以恢復飛行準備了. [EMOJI=rocket]

node.id: I can now override this shelter security system to attract the monsters out of the [ORANGE]shelter[WHITE] nearby.
node.to: 我現在可以覆蓋這個庇護所安全系統，吸引怪物離開附近的[ORANGE]庇護所[WHITE].

node.id: I should find more of these [MATERIAL_ICON=CPU].
Found a strange source of energy.
node.to: 找到了一種奇怪的能量來源.

node.id: I should go to that energy source at some point.
node.to: 我應該在可以找到那個能源.

node.id: It's like time and space are bent around this spot... [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 就好像時間和空間圍繞著這個點旋轉... [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: I should investigate this phenomenon further...
node.to: 我應該進一步調查這一現象...

node.id: Empty! Maybe I should have came here sooner... [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 空的！也許我應該早點來這裡... [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: The Law of Borealis Corrective Facility
We have an order to deliver timber to the base west of Chalice on Monday morning.
node.to: 我們接到訂單，要在週一早上把木材運到聖杯西面的基地.

node.id: Whew, this reeks really bad.. but I think I found something..
node.to: 哇，這氣味真難聞。。但我想我找到了一些東西..

node.id: "He hasn't been cooperative on telling us about his accomplice."
node.to: "他不肯合作告訴我們他的同謀."

node.id: The [ORANGE]Escape Pod[WHITE] should not be far. Now where's the [ORANGE]Launchpad[WHITE]?
node.to: [ORANGE]套升艙[WHITE] 應該就在附近。 但是 [ORANGE]發射台[WHITE]在什麼地發?

node.id: \t" Probably went hiding in his [ORANGE]Fortress[WHITE]. We can't do anything without the key."
node.to: \t" 可能躲在 [ORANGE]堡壘[WHITE]裡. 但是我們沒有鑰匙."

node.id: It's locked down tight! That antenna must be important.[EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 鎖得很嚴實！那天線一定很重要.[EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: That's quite a bit of water damage... [EMOJI=frowning face]
node.to: 這損失了很多的水... [EMOJI=frowning face]

node.id: I need to find another way into the [ORANGE]Launchpad[WHITE]
node.to: 我得另找一條路進入 [ORANGE]發射台[WHITE]

node.id: I shouldn't leave empty handed though. Mana is too precious to leave behind.
node.to: 不過我不應該空手而歸。神力太寶貴了，不能留下.

node.id: There's the issue. Should be easy to fix... [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 這就是問題所在。應該很容易修復。.. [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: The horde behind that gate is drawn to the escape pod mana engine.
node.to: 門後的怪物被吸引到神力引擎逃生艙.

node.id: I may need to fight them.
node.to: 我可能需要和他們戰鬥.

node.id: I should build defenses before fixing the engine.
node.to: 我應該在修理引擎之前建立防禦系統.

node.id: There's even a [EMOJI=crown]Crown flight suit with a parachute for the trip.
node.to: 旅行過程中， 有一套帶降落傘的[EMOJI=crown]皇冠飛行服 .

node.id: I can leave whenever I want now.
With the Undercrown entrance collapsed and the end of the world happening outside there is not much to do?
node.to: 隨著皇冠下入口的倒塌，世界末日在外面發生，沒有什麼可做的了？

node.id: We can only hunker down in the pass and hope for a miracle.
node.to: 我們只能蜷縮在山口，期待奇跡的出現.
孟席斯山口東門終點站

node.id: I should head [GREEN]east[WHITE], but it might sense to explore a little first.
node.to: 我應該向[GREEN]東邊[WHITE]走，但還是應該先探索一下.

node.id: I might be able to scan the area using that [GREEN]link tower[WHITE]. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 我可以用那個[GREEN]連接塔[WHITE]掃描這個區域. [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: I could be able to scan the area using that link tower. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 我可以用那個連接塔掃描這個區域. [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: I can't get past the [GREEN]gate[WHITE] with that large monster standing in the way! [EMOJI=grimacing face]
node.to: 我無法越過[GREEN]大門[WHITE]，因為那個大怪物擋著我的路！[EMOJI=grimacing face]

node.id: I should head to that [ORANGE]link tower[WHITE] to [GREEN]open the gate[WHITE]. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 我應該前往那個[ORANGE]鏈塔[WHITE] 來 [GREEN]打開大門[WHITE]. [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: I guess I should go and activate those [GREEN]Link Relays[WHITE]. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 我想我應該去啟動這些 [GREEN]鏈塔[WHITE]. [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: [RED]NO[WHITE] Sanctuary for all those who arrive!
node.to: [RED]沒有[WHITE] 庇護所可以提供給這些到達的人了！
孟席斯山口南門終點站

node.id:
Menu:
Ark Soup
Founder's Fish'n'Chips
Crash Site Cafe
Crater Pie
The Burger That Reappears
node.to:
菜單:
方舟湯
炸魚片
墜機咖啡館
火山口派
重現漢堡

node.id: [BLUE]SAFETY FIRST[WHITE]\n 2 days since the last disaster.
node.to: [BLUE]安全第一[WHITE]\n 上次災難發生後兩天.

node.id: Some Sunday Woodsman keeps [GREEN]burying their junk[WHITE] in the forest.\nThe latest "stash" can be found somewhere between the Hunter's Cabin and the two nearest riverside shacks.
node.to: 星期天伐木工人一直在森林裡[GREEN]掩埋他們的垃圾[WHITE]。\n最新的"藏匿處"可以在獵人的小屋和最近的兩個河邊棚屋之間找到.

node.id: Don't worry little car, I'm sure Fincher's got your best interest in mind.
node.to: 別擔心，我相信芬奇已經為我們考慮了.

node.id: "A word of warning. Be wary of extremely hot local temperatures. Military activity in the area is also at heightened state. Southern parts are inaccessible."
node.to: "一句警告的話。要警惕當地酷熱的氣溫。該地區的軍事活動也處於緊張狀態。南部地區無法進入."

node.id: It says here that the Salvage is located [ORANGE]North[WHITE] from here. Could the car be there? [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 這裡寫著打撈物位於[ORANGE]北部[WHITE]。汽車會在那裡嗎？ [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: [RED]GO AWAY[WHITE]\nUse of deadly force is very probable.
node.to: [RED]快走開[WHITE]\n使用致命武力的可能性很大.

node.id: [GREEN]Sanctuary[WHITE] for all of those who arrive!
node.to: [GREEN]庇護所[WHITE] 提供給所有到達的人!

node.id: Stay at the Blue Ponds Motel for two or more nights and get a free coffee!
node.to: 在汽車旅館住兩晚或兩晚以上，免費喝咖啡!

node.id: There is a hidden note behind the painting:\n 'Dear accomplice. The items are getting a bit too hot to keep in here. I've stashed both the car's key and its location behind the [GREEN]Office Toilet Seat[WHITE]. Meet me later.'
node.to: 這幅畫後面有一張隱藏的字條：\n'親愛的同伴。這些東西有點棘手 了，不能放在這裡。我把車鑰匙和它的位置都藏在 [GREEN]辦公室馬桶座[WHITE]後面。待會兒見。'

node.id: Archaeological Digsite. Access prohibited for persons without permission.
node.to: 考古發掘現場。未經許可，禁止人員進入.

node.id: The Reaper at the Holiday Resort
Some kind of an idol? I wonder if the rest of it is underground? [EMOJI=moai]
node.to: 某種偶像？我想知道它的其他部分是否在地下？ [EMOJI=moai]

node.id: Everything is carefully placed. I wish there had been more mana to build extra campfires.
node.to: 所有的東西都被小心得安放著。我希望有更多的神力來建造更多的營火。

node.id: Get the gate open to gain access to the [ORANGE]Launchpads[WHITE].
node.to: 把門打開，以便進入房間 [ORANGE]發射台[WHITE].

node.id: Mana is too precious to leave behind. Load the Escape Pod with some Mana Chunks and Tomb Orbs.
node.to: 神力太寶貴了，不能留下。在逃生艙中裝載一些法神力塊和墓穴球.

node.id: Warm up the Escape Pod engine.

There is a lone notebook page on the ground: One of the guests is reportedly acting suspiciously. She has been seen moving valuable looking items around, maybe even contraband. \n The [ORANGE]Motel's Office[WHITE] should have the guest and room info.
node.to: 地上有一頁筆記本：據報導，其中一位元客人的行為可疑。有人看到她四處移動貴重物品，甚至可能是違禁品\n[ORANGE]汽車旅館的辦公室[WHITE] 應該有客人和房間的資訊。”.

node.id: The Polaris Gate is now open. What could possibly lie beyond it?
node.to: 北極星之門現在打開了。裡面會有什麼東西呢

node.id: You have encountered a strange phenomenon crackling with unnatural energy that seems to affect your perception of time. It is a peculiar puzzle that should be investigated further.
node.to: 你遇到了一種奇怪的現象，這種現象伴隨著非自然的能量，似乎會影響你對時間的感知。這是一個需要進一步研究的特殊難題.

node.id: You arrive in a peculiar room that contains a swirling vortex of energy. It seems to be what you were looking for.
node.to: 你到達一個特殊的房間，裡面有一個能量漩渦。這似乎就是你要找的.

node.id: The Ark is now complete. What mysteries will the Level 2 contain?
node.to: 方舟現在完成了。二級關卡有什麼秘密？

node.id: For all is lost if he lays his eyes on our innocent people again.
node.to: 因為如果他再次把視線投向我們無辜的人民，一切都將失去.

node.id: They used a sharpened spoon-like tool for the operation.
node.to: 他們使用了一個削尖的勺子狀工具進行手術.

node.id: For all is lost if he strides over the earth again.
node.to: 如果他再次踏上地球，一切都將失去.

node.id: Walking is difficult when all your bones are shattered.
node.to: 當你的骨頭都碎了的時候，走路是很困難的.

node.id: For all is lost if he poisons the air with his lies again.
node.to: 因為如果他再次用謊言毒害空氣，一切都將失去.

node.id: Cutting off the tongue is as painful as it sounds.
node.to: 切斷舌頭聽起來很痛苦.

node.id: So I escaped... And left everything behind.
There was the accident of course.
Something wrong with the escape pod thruster.
But that was only the beginning...
Everyone will be provided a safe transit as soon as possible.
node.to: 將儘快為每個人提供安全的交通工具.
個人音訊日誌。關於誠實.

node.id: I know I haven't been completely honest. I know I may have lied here and there.
node.to: 我知道我不是完全誠實的。我知道我可能到處撒謊.

node.id: But certain things need to happen in a certain order. I can't risk it.
node.to: 但某些事情需要按照自然發生順序。我不能冒險.

node.id: We all do what we must just to survive... Just to exist.
node.to: 我們都做我們必須做的 只是為了生存。。。只是為了生存。
個人音訊日誌。關於提醒.

node.id: During my refuge I will lose grip of reality.
node.to: 在我避難所時光裡，我將失去對現實的把握.

node.id: I need to find a way to remind myself of what's important.
node.to: 我需要想辦法提醒自己什麼是重要的.

node.id: Something I can't destroy even when my mind goes to dark places.
node.to: 即使我的思想進入黑暗的地方，我也無法被摧毀

node.id: Something I can't reach until I have regained myself.
node.to: 在我恢復之前我無法觸及的東西.

node.id: The latest iteration of the voice synth is good enough.
node.to: 語音合成器的最新反覆運算已經足夠好了.

node.id: The automated broadcasts will start immediately.
Personal audio log. About the timeline of all of this.
node.to: 個人音訊日誌。關於這一切的時間表.

node.id: The crash. The Ivory Man and the pestilence. The pyramid. Abby.
node.to: 撞車。象牙人和瘟疫。金字塔。艾比.

node.id: After that everything is clear. My reign. The shelter and the escape.
node.to: 之後一切都清楚了。我的統治。避難所和逃生之路.

node.id: But lots of questions still remain.
node.to: 但仍有許多問題有待解決.

node.id: How much do I dare stray from my path?
node.to: 我敢在多大程度上偏離我的道路?

node.id: Or do I even have a say in this?
node.to: 或者我在這件事上有發言權嗎？
個人音訊日誌。關於死亡.

node.id: I've had plenty of time to contemplate death.
node.to: 我有足夠的時間思考死亡.

node.id: I don't understand why I am the way I am, but I'm starting to learn the rules.
node.to: 我不明白我為什麼會這樣，但我開始學習規則了.

node.id: I don't know if I can truly die, but I do bleed like everyone else.
node.to: 我不知道我是否真的會死，但我確實和其他人一樣流血。

node.id: When I do die, it's only dark for just a moment, and then I feel the Flame.
node.to: 當我真的死了，它只是黑暗的一瞬間，然後我感覺到火焰.

node.id: I don't need to eat or sleep, yet I enjoy both.
node.to: 我不需要吃飯或睡覺，但我兩者都喜歡.

node.id: I always carry the pills with me though. Not repeating that mistake ever again.
node.to: 不過我總是帶著藥片。不再重蹈覆轍.
個人音訊日誌。關於神力.

node.id: Mana is extremely valuable. We must not lose this knowledge.
node.to: 神力是非常寶貴的。我們不能失去這方面的知識.

node.id: I can't wait to share this with the rest of the world.
node.to: 我迫不及待地想和全世界分享這一點.

node.id: But we need to overcome the Pestilence first.
node.to: 但我們首先需要戰勝瘟疫.

node.id: How can I fix this? Or can I even fix this? Are we doomed each time?
node.to: 我怎樣才能解決這個問題？或者我能解決這個問題嗎？我們每次都是命中註定的嗎？

node.id: This is frustrating. Makes me want to break things.
node.to: 這太令人沮喪了。讓我想打破一切.

node.id: That's it. I'm ready to leave I guess. [EMOJI=neutral face]
node.to: 就這樣。我想我已經準備好離開了. [EMOJI=neutral face]

node.id: I should inspect more of these. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 我應該多檢查一下. [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: This is interesting. I think I need to somehow power up these obelisks.
node.to: 這很有趣。我想我應該啟動這些方尖碑.

node.id: I should inspect one more for additional clues. [EMOJI=detective]
node.to: 我應該再檢查一個，尋找更多的線索. [EMOJI=detective]

node.id: I think I know how to use these now. I should prepare fighting for my life though.
node.to: 我想我現在知道怎麼使用這個了。不過我應該準備好為我的生命而戰.

node.id: The gas is getting to my lungs. I need a [GREEN]Gas Mask[WHITE].
node.to: 氣體進入我的肺部. 我需要一個 [GREEN]賭氣面具[WHITE].

node.id: There are strange obelisks all over the island. Find out if they could be useful somehow.
node.to: 島上到處都是奇怪的方尖碑。看看它們是否有什麼用處.

node.id: The obelisks make you stronger, but only one of them can be active at a time. Choose wisely.
node.to: 方尖碑讓你更強壯，但一次只能啟動其中一個。明智的選擇.
允許打開和進入 [BLUE]神力裂縫[WHITE].

node.id: Unlocks Refiner machine which can be used to turn lower grade materials into higher grade ones.
node.to: 解鎖精煉機 可用於將低級物料轉換為高級物料.

node.id: Buildable Rocket Turret that deals explosive splash damage to several monsters at once.
node.to: 火箭炮塔，一次對多個怪物造成爆炸性全體傷害.

node.id: Buildable defensive structures that will help slow down the rush of monsters.
node.to: 防禦設施有助於減緩怪物的衝刺.

node.id: Increased ammo capacity for all turrets.
node.to: 增加所有炮塔的彈藥容量.

node.id: A perfect fillet seasoned with spices and grilled golden brown. Served with fresh spring onions.
node.to: 用香料和金黃調味的完美魚片。與新鮮的蔥一起食用.

node.id: A crusty baked seafood pie that has a fresh and crispy taste.
node.to: 一種有新鮮和酥脆味道的硬皮烤海鮮餡餅

node.id: A carefully prepared risotto dish with a fillet of delicious zander on top.
node.to: 一道精心準備的義大利飯，上面有一片美味的香腸.

node.id: Unlocks [GREEN][RECIPE_NAME=ANIMAL_TREATS][WHITE] Recipe. [GREEN]Animal Friendliness[WHITE] makes animals less afraid of you.
node.to: 解鎖 [GREEN][RECIPE_NAME=ANIMAL_TREATS][WHITE] 圖譜. [GREEN]動物友好性[WHITE] 讓動物不那麼害怕你.

node.id: Animals that are following you fight by your side.
node.to: 身邊的動物和你一起戰鬥.

node.id: These seeds produce a vegetable with an edible taproot.
node.to: 這些種子生長一種有可食主根的蔬菜.

node.id: These seeds grow into bushy plants with big edible berries.
node.to: 這些種子長成濃密的植物，結有大的可食用的漿果.

node.id: When these vegetable seeds are planted, they eventually grow bushy leaves overground.
node.to: 當這些蔬菜種子被種植時，它們最終會在地上長出濃密的葉子.

node.id: These seeds produce an edible 'tuber' underground, the location of which is marked by green leaves overground.
node.to: 這些種子在地下產生一種可食用的食物.

node.id: A leafy stalk is produced from these kernels. At the top of the stalk there is a concentration of more kernels called 'an ear'.
node.to: 葉柄是由這些穀粒製成的。在莖的頂端有更多的穀粒，稱為“穗”'.

node.id: After planting these seeds, a stem grows out underground and eventually begins to swell into a round edible 'bulb'.
node.to: 種植這些種子後，莖在地下生長，最終開始膨脹成圓形的可食“球莖”'.

node.id: These seeds produce a type of grass with harvestable crops at the end of a long stalk.
node.to: 這些種子產生一種在長莖末端有可收穫作物的草.

node.id: Fill 10 material slots full of materials.
Fill 8 material slots with the same type of material.
node.to: 用相同類型的材料填充8個材料槽.

node.id: Light all Campfires on the Island.
Discover and activate all Link Towers on the Island.
node.to: 找到並啟動島上的所有鏈塔.

node.id: Complete all Tombs on the Island.
node.to: 完成島上所有的墳墓挖掘.

node.id: Grow and harvest any 6 different types of plants.
node.to: 種植和收穫6種不同類型的植物.
殺死100個任何類型的怪物.

node.id: Build It And They Will Come
node.to: 建造它 他們就會來
建造10個任意類型的結構.

node.id: Use all Wishing Wells on the Island.
node.to: 使用島上所有的許願井.

node.id: Travel through all the Rifts on the Island.
Open all Timed Chests on the Island.
node.to: 打開島上所有的時間箱子.

node.id: Visit all shelters on the Island.
node.to: 參觀島上所有的避難所.

node.id: Dig up all buried treasures on the Island.
node.to: 挖掘島上所有埋藏的寶藏d.

node.id: Max out all the Obelisks on the Island.
node.to: 把島上所有的方尖碑都挖出來了.

node.id: Investigate all the Myth Tablets on the Island.
node.to: 調查島上所有的神話石碑.
收聽50個不同的廣播節目.

node.id: Complete all Points of Interest on all locations.
node.to: 完成所有位置上的所有興趣點.

node.id: Upgrade 7 Tools to the maximum level.
node.to: 將7個工具升級到最高級別.

node.id: The structure has become increasingly active for as yet unknown reasons. It is affecting the flow of time around it and is also causing some local spatial anomalies.
node.to: 由於未知的原因，該結構變得越來越活躍。它影響著周圍的時間流動，也造成了一些局部的空間異常

node.id: Installed Transmitters affect this Link Tower area.
node.to: 安裝的變送器會影響該連接塔區域.

node.id: Follow the map and dig up the hidden treasures in [LOCATION=HOME_SUBURB].
node.to: 跟著地圖，把隱藏在[LOCATION=HOME_SUBURB]的寶藏挖出來.

node.id: A four legged, hoofed herbivore mammal found in arctic areas. Popularly known as reindeer.
node.to: 北極地區的一種四足、有蹄的食草動物。俗稱馴鹿.

node.id: A carrion bird, seen circling above potential prey awaiting their demise.
node.to: 一種腐肉鳥，在潛在獵物上方盤旋等待死亡.

node.id: Heavy is the head that bears the crown but heavier yet is the weight of the throne on the backs of those holding it up.
node.to: 王冠是沉重的，但是王冠背後責任是的更沉重.

node.id: Law should protect the rights and the needs of the many, not serve the interests of the few.
node.to: 法律應該保護多數人的權利和需要，而不是服務於少數人的利益.

node.id: Death does not discriminate, it is the great equalizer. When facing the infinity everyone is on the same line.
node.to: 死亡沒有歧視，它是偉大的等化器。面對無限時，每個人都站在同一條線上”.

node.id: The act of drawing your weapon is always an easier one to make than the act of sheathing it and ending the violence.
node.to: 拔出武器要比放下武器或者停止暴力容易.

node.id: Towering above his compatriots, the captain of the guard is a ferocious adversary.
node.to: 衛兵隊長站在同胞之間，是一個兇猛的對手.

node.id: This ex human uses different types of melee attacks to bring down its target.
node.to: 這個非人類使用不同類型的近戰攻擊擊落目標.

node.id: Highly acrobatic, the leaper is able to pounce upon unsuspecting prey from far away.
node.to: 跳躍怪能夠從遠處突襲毫無戒備的獵物.

node.id: The Mutated Hurler has the power to level its surroundings via clusters of explosive projectiles and it almost seems to revel in the mayhem it causes.
node.to: 變異投手怪有能力通過爆炸性的炮彈將周圍的一切夷為平地，它似乎對自己造成的混亂感到欣喜若狂.

node.id: Existing in the darkness below the ground has made the Dweller lose its eyesight. It relies almost purely on sounds for navigation.
node.to: 長期生活地下，黑暗使居居住者失去了視力。它幾乎完全依靠聲音來導航.

node.id: A mutated form of a tropical flower that spits out toxic sludge when it senses lifeforms nearby.
node.to: 一種變異的熱帶花，當它感覺到附近有生命時會吐出有毒的淤泥.

node.id: An ancient warrior that chose to take an oath and become a warden of tombs.
node.to: 一位墳墓看守人的古代戰士.

node.id: I should head to the [ORANGE]Evac Site[WHITE]. I can always come back here later.
node.to: 我應該去[ORANGE]撤離地點[WHITE].我隨時會回來

node.id: These must be the repair parts for the train at [LOCATION=MINE_1]
node.to: 在[LOCATION=MINE_1]地方的列車的這些部件必須要被修改好 [LOCATION=MINE_1]
[RED]避難所[WHITE] 為到來的人提供庇護!

node.id: Some Sunday Woodsman keeps [GREEN]burying their junk[WHITE] in the forest.\nThe latest "stash" can be found somewhere between the Hunter's Cabin and the two nearest riverside shacks.
node.to: 一些星期天的伐木工人一直[GREEN]把他們的垃圾埋在[WHITE] 森林裡.\nThe latest "stash" 可以在獵人小屋和最近的兩個河邊小屋之間找到.

node.id: Area closed until further notice.\nCrown Archaeological Expedition
node.to: 區域封閉，另行通知.\n皇冠考古隊

node.id: I can barely read the faded letters on this sign. It must've been written decades before the cataclysm! [EMOJI=hushed face]
node.to: 我幾乎看不清這個牌子上褪色的字母。它一定是在大災難發生前幾十年寫的! [EMOJI=hushed face]

node.id: A new Sawmill is now ready to use. It would seem advantageous to have [GREEN]multiples[WHITE] of this machine.
node.to: 一家新的鋸木廠現已投入使用。如果有[GREEN]多幾台[WHITE]這樣機器，就更好了.

node.id: A new metal Smelter is now ready to use. It would seem advantageous to have [GREEN]multiples[WHITE] of this machine.
node.to: 一家新的金屬冶煉廠現已投入使用。如果有[GREEN]多幾台[WHITE]這樣機器，就更好了.

node.id: Dig up the stashes shown on the drawn map.
node.to: 挖出的地圖上顯示的隱藏物。

node.id: After spending years upon years in his underground shelter he has resurfaced with the aim of finding a way off the island.
node.to: 多年來，他一直呆在地下避難所裡，為了找到一條離開小島的路，他重新回到地面.

node.id: But I've got to keep trying.
This circle of life, lived through it many times.
node.to: 這是生命迴圈，經歷很多次.

node.id: Save has been restored to the moment before entering the escape pod. [GREEN]Main Quest[WHITE] is now complete. You can continue completing [GREEN]Side Quests[WHITE] and other activities.
node.to: 保存已恢復到進入逃生艙前的時刻。 [GREEN]主線任務[WHITE] 現在已經完成. 您可以繼續完成[GREEN]支線任務[WHITE] 和其他的任務.

node.id: You picked up and stored [AMOUNT] materials.
Link tower at maximum ascension level.
node.to: 連結塔處於最大上升高度.

node.id: Only one Obelisk can be active at the same time.
..This went from bad to worse really quick!
So are we supposed to walk on floating ice to get out now that those walkways have collapsed?
node.to: 既然那些人行道已經坍塌了，我們應該在浮冰上行走嗎?

node.id: Week 5: Lucas and Bill will head outside to scavenge for food. Ted and Kristoff will continue research.
node.to: 第五周: 盧卡斯和比爾將去外面尋找食物。特德和克裡斯托夫將繼續研究.

node.id: So who is going to break the news to the excess people in the worker's quarter that someone needs to go?
node.to: 誰會向工人區的多餘人員透露有人需要離開的消息呢?

node.id: Keep the morale high! Report to the CO immediately in case you exhibit signs of mental breakdown!
node.to: 保持高昂的士氣！如果你表現出精神崩潰的跡象，立即向CO報告!

node.id: Orders are to wait for the topside to quiet down and then reclaim the surface.
node.to: 等待上部結構平靜下來，然後收回表面.

node.id: With this geothermal plant we should be able to sustain this facility indefinitely.
node.to: 有了這個地熱發電廠，我們應該能夠無限期地維持這個設施.

node.id: Move Virtual Stick to Touch Position
node.to: 將虛擬杆移動到觸摸位置

node.id: Drag controls to their desired positions
node.to: 將操控拖動到所需位置

node.id: Double barreled sawed-off shotgun with a wide spread.
node.to: 雙管大區域射擊截短霰彈槍.

node.id: A ranged weapon that fires multiple smaller projectiles.
node.to: 發射多個較小射彈的遠端武器.

node.id: Allows [GREEN]Fast Travelling[WHITE] between [ORANGE]Campfires[WHITE] on this [ORANGE]Link Tower Area[WHITE].
node.to: 可以在[ORANGE]鏈塔覆蓋區域下[WHITE][ORANGE]所有營地[WHITE] 快速移動.

node.id: Hold down [BUTTON=TOOL_1] to strike a [GREEN]power attack[WHITE] when locked to a melee target. Tap a monster to toggle melee target.
node.to: 當鎖定近戰目標後， 按住 [BUTTON=TOOL_1] 釋放 [GREEN]強力進攻[WHITE]. 點擊不同怪物 可以切換近戰目標.

node.id: I need to build a platform here first.
node.to: 我需要先在這裡搭建一個平臺.
發明[RECIPE_ICON=COMPASS] 羅盤開啟 [GREEN]快速行動[WHITE].

node.id: Install a [ORANGE]Link Tower Transmitter[WHITE] to enable [GREEN]Fast Traveling[WHITE] to this [ORANGE]Campfire[WHITE].
node.to: 安裝一個 [ORANGE]鏈塔發射機[WHITE] 可以讓 [GREEN]快速穿行[WHITE] 到 [ORANGE]營火[WHITE].

node.id: Select [GREEN]Link Tower[WHITE] or [ORANGE]Campfire[WHITE] to travel to.
node.to: 選擇需要到底的[GREEN]鏈塔[WHITE] 或者 [ORANGE]營火[WHITE].

node.id: Find any [ORANGE]Link Tower[WHITE] to scan for [GREEN]Anomalies[WHITE].
node.to: 找到任何 [ORANGE]鏈塔[WHITE]來掃描 [GREEN]異常現象[WHITE].

node.id: Travel to the location of the [GREEN]Anomalous Signal[WHITE] source.
node.to: 移動到 [GREEN]異常信號[WHITE] 發射源.

node.id: Find and investigate all [ORANGE]Tablets[WHITE] in The Catacombs.
node.to: 調查並找到 [ORANGE]藥品[WHITE] 在地下墓穴裡.

node.id: Find [ORANGE]The Entrance[WHITE] and travel through it.
node.to: 找到 [ORANGE]入口[WHITE] 並且進入.

node.id: [GREEN]Investigate[WHITE] the area and get the [ORANGE]Anomalous Signal[WHITE] back.
node.to: [GREEN]調查[WHITE]該區域並且找到[ORANGE]異常信號地[WHITE] .
移動到 [GREEN]異常信號[WHITE] 發射源.
[GREEN]超負荷[WHITE] 能量傳遞 地點在 [LOCATION=DLC1_TOWN_RELAY].
[GREEN]調查[WHITE] 這個 [ORANGE]異常信號[WHITE] 發射源
發明 [GREEN]營火三角測量[WHITE] 發射台.

node.id: Install [GREEN]Campfire Triangulation[WHITE] to the [ORANGE]Old Link Tower[WHITE].
node.to: 在[ORANGE]老鏈塔[WHITE]上安裝 [GREEN]營火三角測量[WHITE].
檢查這奇怪的水晶裝置

node.id: Kill [VAR.required_amount] Mana Protected enemies while inside the Mana Chamber walls.
node.to: 殺掉 [VAR.required_amount] 魔法室裡保護神力的敵人

node.id: Find [VAR.required_amount] stashes and gather what they contain.
node.to: 找到 [VAR.required_amount]貯藏處並且收集裡面物品 .

node.id: [GREEN]Clear[WHITE] the construction area of any objects.
node.to: [GREEN]清除[WHITE] 建築區域裡面所有物體.

node.id: A very silent ranged weapon which shoots special mana bolts through the air.
node.to: 一種無噪音的的遠端武器，可以在空中發射特殊的神力箭.

node.id: Improved seed bag that enables planting multiple seeds at once. Unlocks planting [MATERIAL_ICON=MANA_BEAD] Mana Beads.
node.to: 加強種子袋，可以一次播種多粒種子。解鎖種植[MATERIAL_ICON=MANA_BEAD] 神力珠.
在一塊3X3的區域種植種子.

node.id: A huge skewered lobster tail brushed with garlic butter all over before grilling. The taste permeates your very soul.
node.to: 將一隻巨大的串龍蝦尾巴上塗滿了大蒜黃油， 然後烤制， 這種味道滲透著你的靈魂.

node.id: Finely chopped shrimp mixed with bread batter cooked in oil to produce a crispy treat.
node.to: 切碎的蝦與麵包糊混合在油中烹製而成的酥脆食物.

node.id: Fresh green salad with flawlessly cooked pieces of lobster further infused with tasty mayo.
node.to: 新鮮的蔬菜沙拉配上完美烹製的龍蝦片，再加入美味的蛋黃醬.

node.id: Plump, cooked shrimp on a plate coupled with a zesty tomato based sauce.
node.to: 在盤子裡放上美味的熟蝦，配上番茄醬。

node.id: Juicy lobster and mayonnaise tucked in a hot dog bun with a side of crispy chips.
node.to: 多汁的龍蝦和蛋黃醬夾在熱狗包子裡，還有一面脆薯片。

node.id: Mana seeds that grow into a strange plant with harvestable crops.
node.to: 神力珠生長成一種奇怪的植物，有可收穫的作物.

node.id: A clawed crustacean living in the water. Highly prized as seafood as the hardened shell conceals delicious meat.
node.to: 生活在水中的有爪甲殼動物。堅硬的外殼隱藏著美味的肉，被視為海鮮.

node.id: Inhabiting the plains of the Underworld, the ghostly and intangible Mana Spirit can catch its prey in the blink of an eye.
node.to: 居住在地下世界的平原上，幽靈般的無形神力精靈可以在眨眼間抓住獵物.

node.id: It has some instructions written on it..
I think it can help me fight the enemies and acquire materials in this area.
node.to: 我認為它可以幫助我打擊敵人並獲取該地區的材料.

node.id: Contains knowledge on how different things are built. Gain more loot in the tower area it is built in.
node.to: 包含關於如何構建不同事物的知識。在塔樓區域獲得更多戰利品.

node.id: Speeds up plant growth time in the tower area it is built in.
node.to: 加快塔樓區域內的植物生長時間.

node.id: Lead animals to the through to give them a home.
node.to: 把動物帶到餵養地給它們一個家.

node.id: Rest at the fireplace to heal, level up and to craft.
node.to: 在壁爐旁休息，進行治療、升級和製作.

node.id: Plants can be grown on the plant bed.
node.to: 植物可以在植物床上生長.

node.id: Refining structures are more efficient in the tower area the transformer is built in.
node.to: 變壓器所在的塔區的精煉結構效率更高.

node.id: Planting of seeds is faster in the tower area the seed cart is built in.
node.to: 種子在有種子車的塔樓區域播種速度更快.

node.id: Materials can be deposited to and withdrawn from the storage box.
node.to: 材料可以存放在儲物箱中，也可以從儲物箱中取出.

node.id: It's some kind of an old antenna? It's radiating energy!
node.to: 是某種舊天線？它在輻射能量!

node.id: Not sure what to do with this yet. I should [GREEN]Investigate[WHITE] the [LOCATION=DLC1_TOWN_RELAY].
node.to: 還不知道該怎麼辦. 我應該 [GREEN]調查[WHITE] 這個 [LOCATION=DLC1_TOWN_RELAY].

node.id: I should test [GREEN]Overloading[WHITE] the [LOCATION=DLC1_TOWN_RELAY] relay first.
node.to: 我應該首先測試 [GREEN]繼電器[LOCATION=DLC1_TOWN_RELAY] 超載問題[WHITE]

node.id: Not sure what to do with this yet. I should go to the [ORANGE]Signal Source[WHITE].
node.to: 還不知道該怎麼辦. 我應該到 [ORANGE]信號源[WHITE]地方.

node.id: That does it. [GREEN]Couple[WHITE] more to go.
How is it that these things are still operational after all this time? [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 經過這麼長時間，這些東西怎麼還能運行？ [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: Another [GREEN]Energy Relay[WHITE] deactivated. No more relaying for you.
node.to: 另外一個 [GREEN]能量繼電器[WHITE]被發現. 沒有其它的了.

node.id: Why didn't the they do this themselves? [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 為什麼他們自己不這麼做？ [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: That's the last [GREEN]Energy Relay[WHITE] [EMOJI=victory hand] Now back to the see what the Signal is about!
node.to: 這個是最後一個 [GREEN]能量繼電器[WHITE] [EMOJI=victory hand] 現在回去看看信號是關於什麼的!

node.id: I should go to see what the signal is.
node.to: 我應該去看看信號是什麼.

node.id: Create lumber and wood products out of scrap wood.
node.to: 用廢木料製造木材和木製品.

node.id: Crafted items can be upgraded on the workbench without resting at a campfire.
node.to: 手工製作的物品可以在工作臺上升級，而無需到營火旁休息.

node.id: Cook food recipes on the stove.
node.to: 在爐子上烹飪食物食譜.

node.id: Tap the [GREEN]CROWBAR[WHITE] icon to strike and destroy objects.
node.to: 點擊 [GREEN]撬棍[WHITE] 圖示打擊並摧毀物體.

node.id: Not safe any more! Stay away!

node.to: 私有財產\n象牙山\n禁止入內

node.id: "Half of our people are already gone. We must destroy the devices or we all will perish!."
node.to: "我們一半的人已經走了。我們必須摧毀這些設備，否則我們都會滅亡！."

node.id: Do not go past the doors without permission!
node.to: 未經允許，不要從門口經過!

node.id: I almost blasted myself into smithereens moving these darned barrels. Someone else can do it. I quit!
node.to: 搬動這些該死的桶，差點把自己炸成碎片。讓其他人去搬吧。我不幹了!

node.id: "Card game night with the town station workers this Friday."
node.to: "本週五是鎮車站工作人員的紙牌遊戲之夜."

node.id: "The device's healing powers gives you the vitality of a young man! We must get closer to them."
node.to: "該設備的治療能力讓你充滿活力！我們必須靠近他們."

node.id: Now that's a big drop. I should find another route to the other side.
node.to: 現在我應該另找一條路去另一邊.

node.id:
Product ideas for mana?
Gasoline replacement
Jewelry for dames
Fancy warmer for your flippers
Wireless electricity
Invigorating medicine products
node.to:
神力概念?
汽油替代品
女士珠寶
想給你的腳穿暖和點嗎
無線電力
補益藥品

node.id: Another Link Tower. The rusty thing looks ancient. [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]
node.to: 另一個鏈塔。這個生銹的東西看起來很古老. [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]

node.id: It's powered down. I hope I don't cut myself on it. [EMOJI=grimacing face]
node.to: 它斷電了。我希望我不要在上面割傷自己. [EMOJI=grimacing face]

node.id: The potential is limitless! We must get this stuff patented.
node.to: 潛力無限！我們必須申請專利.

node.id: "The nicked Crown Tower works good enough as a test bench. I hope they don't come looking for it. "
node.to: "有切口的皇冠塔作為試驗台已經足夠好了。我希望他們不是來找它的. "

node.id: "If you don't come up with new product ideas soon, the company will go under!"
node.to: "如果你不儘快想出新的產品創意，公司就會破產!"

node.id: 100% pure SNORT brand gasoline [EMOJI=fuel pump]\nYou can tell by the smell that it's good!
node.to: 100% 純汽油 [EMOJI=fuel pump]\n你可以從氣味判斷它很棒!

node.id: ''Continue exploring further from the town limits. Still dangerous to move around. Fortifying the entrances should be a priority.''
node.to: ''繼續探索遠離城鎮邊界的地方。四處走動仍然很危險。加固入口應該是一個優先事項.''

node.id: Gunn's General Store. Open at all hours.
node.to: 百貨商店 全天候營業.
伯納德的優質墓碑和紀念品

node.id: "The raft idea is foolhardy. Where do they think they are going to go? So wasteful and I can't stop them."
node.to: "木筏的想法太魯莽了。他們認為自己會去哪裡？太浪費了，我無法阻止他們."

node.id: If the bridge is up, use the path marked with [GREEN]Green Mana[WHITE].
node.to: 如果橋在上面，使用標有 [GREEN]綠色的神力[WHITE].

node.id: ''Are we alive? Do we even exist anymore?''
node.to: ''我們還活著嗎？我們還存在嗎？''

node.id: "Folks at the radio station say that they heard voices from their receivers until the power levels to went too low."
node.to: "廣播站的人說，他們聽到了來自接收器的聲音."

node.id: The Radio Royale. Island States' official radio station
node.to: 皇家電臺，島國官方電臺

node.id: "There are at least two other devices, maybe even four. We should be able to map the locations soon enough."
node.to: "至少還有兩台其他設備，甚至可能有四台。我們應該很快就能繪製出這些地點的地圖."

node.id: "The idea about using specific radio resonance to make the crystals weaker was brilliant."
node.to: "利用特定的無線電共振使晶體變弱的想法非常棒."

node.id: The signal is back! It's weak though.
I should go to check that signal at some point.
node.to: 我應該在某個時候去檢查那個信號.

node.id: "Wireless transport of matter? Tesla himself wanted nothing to do with this. Not after the incident."
node.to: "物質的無線傳輸？特斯拉本人不想與此有任何關係。事件發生後就沒有了."

node.id: " Mapped using the radio equipment at the station. Thanks guys! "
node.to: "使用電臺的無線電設備繪製地圖。謝謝大家！ "

node.id: It's a map. I think I can figure this out.
node.to: 這是一張地圖。我想我能弄明白.

node.id: "The artificial reproductions lack all the qualities of the natural mana crystals."
node.to: "人工複製品缺乏天然神力的水晶的制質."

node.id: "Part of the structure seems to be completely unobservable."
node.to: "部分結構似乎完全無法觀察到."

node.id: "Was this place always here or was it created with the event?"
node.to: "這個地方一直都在這裡嗎？還是它是由活動創造的？"

node.id: I guess I'm not welcome there.
node.to: 我想我在那裡不受歡迎.

node.id: "I do think that the plan to destroy them all is lunacy!."
node.to: "我確實認為摧毀他們的計畫是瘋狂的!."

node.id: " The Energy Relays can be [GREEN]Overloaded[WHITE] and that should take care of them. "
node.to: " 能量繼電器可以 [GREEN]超載[WHITE] 並且應該注意使用. "

node.id: " But it should theoretically stop all of the harmful effects."
node.to: " 但從理論上講，它應該阻止所有的有害影響."

node.id: Destroying the relays sounds like a good plan. I don't get why they are so against it.
node.to: 摧毀繼電器聽起來是個好計畫。我不明白他們為什麼這麼反對.

node.id: "We still have some electricity coming from somewhere. It shouldn't be possible."
node.to: "我們還有一些電從某處來。這應該是不可能的。"

node.id: There's people here? I wonder if they got out [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 這裡有人嗎？我不知道他們是不是出來了 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: The signal is gone. [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow] I should look around if I can find it again. Maybe it shows up.
node.to: 信號消失了. [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]如果我能再找到它，我應該四處看看。也許它會出現.

node.id: You suddenly get the feeling that you should go somewhere. As if some force is pulling you towards it. Find out what is causing it.
node.to: 你突然覺得你應該去某個地方。好像有某種力量把你拉向它。找出原因.

node.id: Follow the signal and explore the area further.
node.to: 跟隨信號，進一步探索該地區.

node.id: Energy Link Relay network needs to be shut down for the Radiation Effects to stop at the [ORANGE]Anomalous Signal Source[WHITE]..
node.to: [ORANGE]異常信號源地區[WHITE]能量繼電器網路需要關閉，輻射效應停止..

node.id: These structures look like they have been modified with some crude technology. Find out if they could be useful somehow.
node.to: 這些結構看起來像是用一些粗糙的技術改造過的。看看它們是否有用.

node.id: The Mana Chambers weaken the mana affected enemies inside the chamber walls and make them drop extra materials.
node.to: 神力室削弱室牆內受神力影響的敵人，使他們掉落額外的材料.

node.id: Destroy 5 Mana Spirits while inside an active Mana Chamber.
node.to: 進入一個神力室 摧毀5個神力精靈.

node.id: The spirits have left. It's safer for now.
node.to: 神力精靈已經離開. 現在安全了

node.id: The involuntary settlers have left behind Hidden stashes for supplies.
node.to: 非自願的定居者留下了隱藏的補給倉庫.

node.id: There's more stashes around the world to find.
node.to: 世界各地還有更多的藏匿處要找.

node.id: There are several audio documentaries scattered around. Listen to them all.
node.to: 有幾部有聲紀錄片散佈在各處。聽聽看.

node.id: The documentaries provide some answers but there's still much to be learned.
node.to: 紀錄片提供了一些答案，但仍有很多東西需要學習.

node.id: Clear the construction area of any objects, then build and furnish yourself a modest adobe.
node.to: 清理建築區域內的任何物體，然後建造並一個普通的土坯.

node.id: Your new dwelling is not very large, but should offer some comfort in these dark times.
node.to: 你的新居不大，但在這樣的黑暗時期應該能給你一些安慰.

node.id: Learn the tale at the Catacombs and travel to the World Beyond.
node.to: 在地下墓穴裡學習這個故事，然後去遠方的世界旅行.

node.id: A Realm on the Edge of Existence, Hidden from the Radiant Sun.
node.to: 一個存在邊緣的王國，隱藏在陽光下.

node.id: Where the Magic of Mana rules and Life and Death are Equals.
node.to: 在這裡 神力和魔力 生和死是平等的。

node.id: There's something for everyone I guess.
node.to: 我想這對每個人都有好處.

node.id: A Realm Corrupted and Defiled by the Greediness of Mortals.
node.to: 一個被凡人的貪婪所腐蝕和玷污的國度.

node.id: The Wellspring of Mana, now Unbound, Untethered.
node.to: 神力之泉，現在已不受束縛，不受束縛.

node.id: Is this where all the Mana comes from? Someone definitely did a big blunder.
node.to: 這就是所有神力的來源嗎？肯定有人犯了大錯.

node.id: A Realm of Immeasurable Power, Bound with Existence itself.
node.to: 一個有著不可估量力量的王國，與存在本身息息相關.

node.id: A Key to Everlasting Life. A way to Alter the Strands of Fate.
node.to: 永生的鑰匙。一種改變命運的方式.

node.id: Who wouldn't want a piece of that?
It recites a story of some mythical world.
node.to: 它講述了一個神話世界的故事.
1.《我的水世界求生》是一款休闲动作冒险游戏。本游戏适用于年满12周岁及以上用户，建议未成年人在家长的监护下使用游戏产品。
2.在《我的水世界求生》的世界里，玩家通过拆除物品，收集资源，拼凑信息，推进游戏剧情，最终收集到所有能量电池，完成游戏，游戏内部不包含语音系统以及陌生人社交系统。
3.本游戏中有用户实名认证系统，未实名账号不能登陆游戏。认证为未成年人的用户将接受以下管理： 未成年玩家可以在周五，周六，周日和法定节假日晚20时至21时登陆游戏，其他时间无法登陆游戏。8周岁以上未满16周岁的用户，单次充值金额不超过50元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过200元人民币；16周岁以上未满18周岁的用户，单次充值金额不得超过100元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过400元人民币。
4.玩家将在《我的水世界求生》里开启一场紧张刺激的动作冒险之旅，解开谜团，努力奋斗，依靠自己的聪明才智逃出生天。

It's possible to travel between campfires in the Underworld. Find a second campfire and use it to Fast Travel to another location.

node.to:
神力的召喚是極其危險的,作為結果世界也被損壞. 儘管已經開闢了新的方式來探索剩下的東西

node.id: Mana makes the infused enemies tougher and impervious to slashing weapons, but clever use of the other tools available should take care of them.
node.to: 神力能讓被灌注的敵人變得更加強大，並且不受近戰武器的影響，但巧妙地使用其他可用的工具應該能解決這些問題.

node.to: 摁住 [BUTTON=TOOL_1] 釋放 [GREEN]蓄力攻擊[WHITE] 當你鎖定近戰目標的時候. 點擊一個怪物來切換目標指示器.

node.id: Hold down [BUTTON=TOOL_1] to strike a [GREEN]power attack[WHITE] when locked to a melee target. Press [BUTTON=TARGET_LOCK] to toggle the target indicator.
node.to: 摁住 [BUTTON=TOOL_1] 釋放 [GREEN]蓄力攻擊[WHITE] 當你鎖定近戰目標的時候. 點擊 [BUTTON=TARGET_LOCK] 切換目標指示器.

node.id: ''The crystals here are hard to mine. Not a lot is usable after it breaks. It just disappears. Reminds me of Prince Rupert's drop actually.''
node.to: ''這裡的水晶很難開採. 在它壞掉之後，沒有多少東西是可用的. 它消失了. 讓我想起了魯珀特王子的墜落.''

node.id: ''The mechanism by which this place captures you is fascinating. It's calling upon your deepest desires and hopes.''
node.to: ''這個地方吸引你的機制很讓人著迷. 它召喚著你內心最深處的渴望.''

node.id: ''I have done it. I now know what Mana is. Or more aptly, I now know what we are. Only one thing left to do.''
node.to: ''我做到了. 我現在知道神力是什麼了. 或者更確切地說，我現在知道我們是什麼了.只剩一件事要做了.''

node.id: ''The device is dangerous. It is in some unholy symbiosis with this place. Losing my mind. My body is stiffening, breaking apart.''
node.to: ''該設備很危險. 它和這個地方有某種邪惡的共生關係. 失去理智. My body is stiffening, breaking apart.''

node.id: ''Half of our people are already gone. We must destroy the devices or we all will perish!''
node.to: ''我們一半的人已經走了。我們必須摧毀這些裝置，否則我們都將滅亡!''

node.id:
Product ideas for mana?
Gasoline replacement [EMOJI=fuel pump]
Jewelry for dames [EMOJI=wrapped gift]
Fancy warmer for your flippers [EMOJI=fire]
Wireless electricity [EMOJI=high voltage]
Invigorating medicine products [EMOJI=flexed biceps]
node.to:
神力的產品創意?
替代燃油 [EMOJI=fuel pump]
給貴婦做珠寶 [EMOJI=wrapped gift]
給拖鞋裝個暖腳器 [EMOJI=fire]
無線輸電 [EMOJI=high voltage]
振興醫藥產品 [EMOJI=flexed biceps]

node.id: ''A portal opened soon after we arrived. We've been led here and now it wants us to leave.''
node.to: ''我們到達後不久，一個傳送門打開了。我們被帶到這裡，現在它要我們離開.''

node.id: ''The device's healing powers give you the vitality of a young man! We must get closer to them.''
node.to: ''這個裝置的治療能力給你年輕人一般的活力!我們必須靠近他們.''

node.id: A Link Tower. The rusty thing looks ancient. [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]
node.to: 一個鏈塔. 這個生銹的東西看起來很古老. [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]

node.id: Someone really wanted to shut it down. I have a suspicion that it didn't help. [EMOJI=worried face]
node.to: 有人真的想把它關掉。我懷疑這並沒有幫助. [EMOJI=worried face]

node.id: It's alive! The radiation is back [EMOJI=grimacing face]
node.to: 它還活著!輻射又回來了 [EMOJI=grimacing face]

node.id: Shouldn't be too hard to fix. [EMOJI=thinking face]
''The nicked Crown Tower works well enough as a test bench. I hope they don't come looking for it.''
node.to: ''有裂縫的皇冠塔作為一個測試台已經足夠好了。我希望他們不是來找它的.''

node.id: A demonstration for the Energy Relays is scheduled for next monday.
node.to: 下週一將舉行能源接力的演示.

node.id: ''We should receive another steel delivery from the [LOCATION=DLC1_FACTORY] next week.''
node.to: ''下周[LOCATION=DLC1_FACTORY]我們應該會收到另一批鋼材.''

node.id: I think this place really does not want me here any more. [EMOJI=loudly crying face]
node.to: 我覺得這個地方真的不想再讓我待在這裡了. [EMOJI=loudly crying face]

node.id: That's what you get for breaking things I guess. [EMOJI=frowning face]
node.to: 我猜這就是摔東西的下場吧. [EMOJI=frowning face]

node.id: 100% pure APEX brand gasoline [EMOJI=fuel pump]\nYou can tell by the smell that it's good!
node.to: 100%純APEX品牌汽油 [EMOJI=fuel pump]\n聞起來就知道品質不錯!

node.id: ''Some kind of symbiosis between the foreign devices and this world. It's using them to lure and trap the living over vast distances?''
node.to: ''外來設備和這個世界之間的某種共生關係。它利用它們來引誘和誘捕遠距離的生物?''

node.id: ''The connection between the displacing blue radiation and the energy relays is certain.''
node.to: ''置換藍輻射和能量繼電器之間的聯繫是確定的.''

node.id: ''Artificial mana crystals are practically useless and disposing of them has proven problematic. The distinct color is easy to spot though.''
node.to: ''人造神力水晶實際上是無用的，如何處理他們也存在問題。雖然顏色很明顯，但還是很容易被發現.''

node.id: ''Mana acts like it's a living thing by itself. Its growth must be nurtured.''
node.to: ''神力就像一個有生命的東西。它的成長必須得到培育.''

node.id: ''I do think that the plan to destroy them all is lunacy!.''
node.to: ''我確實認為摧毀他們的計畫是愚蠢的!.''

node.id: ''[ORANGE]The Energy Relays[WHITE] can be [GREEN]Overloaded[WHITE] and that should take care of them.''
node.to: ''[ORANGE]能量傳遞[WHITE] 可能 [GREEN]超載[WHITE] 需要小心應對.''

node.id: ''But It should theoretically stop all of the harmful effects.''
node.to: ''但理論上它應該能阻止所有的有害影響.''

node.id: So that's what those things are called. Destroying them sounds like a plan if I want to get to that [ORANGE]Signal source[WHITE].
node.to: 這就是這些東西的名字. 摧毀它們聽起來是個不錯的計畫,如果我想找到 [ORANGE]信號源[WHITE].

node.id: ''The idea about using specific radio resonance to make the crystals weaker was brilliant.''
node.to: ''利用特殊的無線電共振使晶體變弱的想法是非常聰明的.''

node.id: Due care must be exercised near the automatic door.
node.to: 在靠近自動門的地方必須格外小心.

node.id: ''I've become quite savvy at climbing during my time here. Out of necessity I suppose.''
node.to: ''在這裡的這段時間裡，我對攀岩已經相當熟練了。我想是出於必要吧.''

node.id: The signal is gone. [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow] I should look around to see if I can find it again. Maybe it will show up.
node.to: 信號消失了. [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow] 我應該四處看看，看看能不能再找到它。也許它會出現.

node.id: The Signal is coming from somewhere here. [EMOJI=compass]
I'm starting to feel adventurous! I should explore the area further. [EMOJI=]
node.to: 我開始想冒險了!我應該進一步探索這個地區. [EMOJI=]

node.id: What was that? It looks like the door opened.
So that World really exists? I'd like to stay on the side of the living though.
node.to: 所以世界真的存在?不過我還是想待在活人這邊.

node.id: Unlimited power? Who wouldn't want a piece of that? I feel like I should go through.
node.to: 無限的能量?誰不想分一杯羹呢?我覺得我應該.

node.id: Someone definitely made a big blunder. It isn't a welcoming place I'm sure.
node.to: 肯定有人犯了個大錯誤。我敢肯定那不是一個歡迎你的地方.

node.id: ''The strange people almost got us. We saw a giant fireball streaking across the sky. Better to stay hidden for now.''
node.to: ''那些奇怪的人差點就抓到我們了。我們看見一個巨大的火球劃過天空。現在最好還是躲起來.''

node.id: ''Three of us made it before it closed. But everything is different up there. It's all wrong.''
node.to: ''我們三個人在關門前趕到了。但在那裡一切都不一樣了。全錯了.''

node.id: It goes even deeper! Shouldn't be far now [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 它走的更深了!現在應該不遠了 [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: I'm starting to feel adventurous! I should explore the area further.
node.to: 我開始想冒險了!我應該進一步探索這個地區.

node.id: Learn the tale at the Catacombs, if you choose to travel to the Underworld.
node.to: 在地下墓穴學習故事，如果你選擇去冥界旅行.

node.id: Where the Magic of Mana rules. Where Life and Death are Equals.
node.to: 這裡是神力的天下。生死平等的地方.

node.id: Heed the words of warning at the Catacombs, if you choose to travel to the Underworld.
node.to: 如果你選擇去冥界，請留意地下墓穴的警告.

node.id: A Perilous Realm Corrupted and Defiled by the Greediness of Mortals.
node.to: 一個被人類的貪婪腐化玷污的危險領域.

node.id: The Wellspring of Mana. Now Unbound, Untethered.
Go through the Gate of Mist at the Catacombs, if you choose to travel to the Underworld.
node.to: 穿過地下墓穴的迷霧之門，如果你選擇前往冥界.

node.id: A Key to Everlasting Life. A Way to Alter the Strands of Fate.
node.to: 永生之鑰。一種改變命運的方法.

node.id: The Doc says that this must be the way out.
I hope he is right, for all of our sakes.
node.to: 我希望他是對的，為了我們所有人.

node.id: They surmise that the passage needs to be opened from both sides.
node.to: 他們推測通道需要從兩邊打開.

node.id: Getting out could take months or even years...
node.to: 越獄可能需要數月甚至數年時間...

node.id: Luckily our people are very resourceful.
node.to: 幸運的是，我們的人神通廣大.

node.id: The tools they have crafted have been very useful so far.
node.to: 到目前為止，他們製作的工具非常有用.

node.id: Don Cook, Documenting for Radio Royale.
node.to: 唐·庫克，為皇家電臺記錄.

node.id: I have tried to piece together a theory on what the heck happened.
node.to: 我試圖拼湊出一個理論來解釋到底發生了什麼事.

node.id: That darn Ivory Mountain firm is the guilty party, that's for sure.
node.to: 那該死的象牙山公司是有罪的一方，這是肯定的.

node.id: I don't think that even the Crown knew of what they were scheming.
node.to: 我覺得就連國王都不知道他們在策劃什麼.

node.id: The man behind the operation could even be trapped here with us.
node.to: 策劃這次行動的人甚至可能被困在這裡.

node.id: Some folks sure would like to lay their hands on him.
node.to: 有些人肯定想把他幹掉.

node.id: Audio recording over. Don Cook for Radio Royale.
node.to: 錄音結束。皇家廣播電臺的唐·庫克.

node.id: Apparently the blue radiation on the hill transports people to this station.
node.to: 顯然山上的藍色輻射把人們送到了這個車站.

node.id: As to why here exactly, well that is still shrouded in mystery.
node.to: 至於為什麼會出現在這裡，這仍然是一個謎.

node.id: Recent discoveries have given us some ideas though.
node.to: 最近的發現給了我們一些想法.

node.id: Doc and our few engineers are slowly trying to crack the case.
node.to: 博士和我們為數不多的幾個工程師正慢慢地試圖破案.

node.id: We still have no clue what happened to the poor fellas who did not arrive here.
node.to: 我們仍然不知道那些沒到這裡的可憐傢伙發生了什麼.

node.id: More of our foodstuffs have gone missing.
node.to: 我們更多的食品不見了.

node.id: The people on the other side of the town are becoming desperate.
node.to: 城市另一邊的人們變得絕望了.

node.id: Fighting each other is futile. It just wastes our resources.
node.to: 互相爭鬥是徒勞的。這只會浪費我們的資源.

node.id: We should be working together on getting out of this wretched place.
node.to: 我們應該一起努力離開這個該死的地方.

node.id: There's a rumor that some people plan to make tracks and skip town.
node.to: 有傳言說有些人打算逃跑.

node.id: The place is getting dangerous, so I think I should vamoose with them.
node.to: 這地方越來越危險了，我想我應該跟他們一起走.

node.id: The escapees must have found another one of those energy link gadgets.
node.to: 逃犯肯定又找到了一個能量連接裝置.

node.id: One should be kept close at all times if you plan to survive out there.
node.to: 如果你想在外面生存，就必須時刻保持距離.

node.id: No sign of the original inhabitants. Lucky me.
node.to: 沒有原始居民的蹤跡。我真幸運.

node.id: I'm starting to think that this joint might actually be haunted!
node.to: 我開始覺得這地方可能真的鬧鬼了!

node.id: We got pounced on by... uh... spirits?
Never seen anything like them before.
node.to: 以前從沒見過這樣的東西.

node.id: I was pursued by one for so long I got separated from the main gang.
node.to: 我被其中一個追了太久，以至於和大團走散了.

node.id: I'm not so sure I can get back to safety with those... things out there.
node.to: 我不確定我能回到安全的地方…那些東西在外面.

node.id: I'm starting to think Doc ain't who he claims to be.
node.to: 我開始覺得醫生不是他自稱的那個人.

node.id: He knows far more about our situation than he's let us on.
node.to: 他知道的情況比他告訴我們的要多得多.

node.id: The man exhibits an intuitive knowledge of exploitation of mana.
node.to: 這個人對神力的利用有直觀的認識.

node.id: There might even be a connection between him and the event that brought us here.
node.to: 也許他和把我們帶到這裡的事件之間有聯繫.

node.id: Doc is playing his own game and the goal ain't getting out of this place.
node.to: 博士在完成他自己的目標目標而不是想從這裡出去.

node.id: People are starting to succumb to the effects of the mana.
node.to: 人們開始屈服於神力的效果了.

node.id: Usage of the energy link gadgets has turned them against us.
node.to: 我們使用的能源連結設備開始與我們作對了.

node.id: They kept us strong and alive for so long.
node.to: 他們讓我們堅強,並且存活了這麼久.

node.id: But like with everything, there is a cost attached.
node.to: 但就像所有事情一樣，這是有成本的.

node.id: There are enemies near. It's not safe to use the device.
node.to: 附近有敵人.使用這個設備不安全.

node.id: I think this is actually a way to go to that place.
node.to: 我認為這實際上是通往那個地方的一種方式.

node.id: More guidance. A warning this time.
node.to: 更多的指導,這次是警告.

node.id: It's a kind of cautious guide on how to travel to some mysterious place.
node.to: 這是一本關於如何去神秘地方旅行的謹慎指南.

node.id: I need to build a doorway here first.
Install [ORANGE]Campfire Triangulation Transmitter[WHITE] to area [ORANGE]Link Tower[WHITE] to enable [GREEN]Fast Traveling[WHITE].
node.to: 安裝 [ORANGE]營火三角測量傳送器[WHITE] 在區域 [ORANGE]鏈塔上[WHITE] 用以開啟 [GREEN]快速旅行[WHITE].

node.id: Activate this Point of Interest first.
This looks like a place where some low-life could live. Only one way to find out. [EMOJI=index pointing up]
node.to: 這裡看起來像是一些下等人可以住的地方。只有一個辦法能知道. [EMOJI=index pointing up]

node.id: There's a note here that says [ORANGE]UNDER[WHITE]
node.to: 這裡有張紙條上寫著 [ORANGE]下面[WHITE]

node.id: I should try and [GREEN]Overload[WHITE] that closest one first for testing purposes.
node.to: 為了測試的目的，我應該嘗試[GREEN]超載[WHITE]最接近的那個.

node.id: And now to find the rest of them [GREEN]Energy Relays[WHITE].
node.to: 現在找到找到剩下的[GREEN]能源繼電器[WHITE].

node.id: And now to find the rest of those [GREEN]Energy Relays[WHITE].
node.to: 現在找到找到剩下的[GREEN]能源繼電器[WHITE].

node.id: The antenna was equipped with a [ORANGE]Campfire Triangulation[WHITE] transmitter.
node.to: 天線配備了一個[ORANGE]營火三角測量[WHITE]發射器.

node.id: Destroying those relays must have broken it. Shouldn't be too hard to replace.
node.to: 摧毀那些繼電器一定把它弄壞了. 替換應該不會太難.

node.id: It's allowing me to move at speed of thought between the campfires.
node.to: 它讓我在營火之間以思維的速度移動.

node.id: The link tower was equipped with a [ORANGE]Campfire Triangulation[WHITE] transmitter.
node.to: 鏈塔裝備了 [ORANGE]營火三角測量[WHITE] 發射器.

node.id: It's broken, but I think It can be replaced. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 它壞了，但我想可以換. [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: That should come handy. Maybe it works on those other towers too?
node.to: 這應該很方便。也許其他塔上也能用?

node.id: There's people here? I wonder if they got out. [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 這裡有人嗎?我想知道他們是否逃出來了. [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: A modern [GREEN]keycard[WHITE]? No wonder they referred to the key as 'strange'.
node.to: 一張現代 [GREEN]鑰匙卡[WHITE]? 難怪他們稱這把鑰匙為“奇怪的”.

node.id: A lonely settlement seemingly survived on its own. Find out if there's anything of value left behind.
node.to: 一個孤獨的定居點似乎靠自己存活了下來。看看有沒有什麼值錢的東西留下.

node.id: A community of thieves lived by taking advantage of others. Fortunately for you, you can't take anything with you after you are dead
node.to: 一群小偷以占別人的便宜為生。幸運的是，你死後什麼也帶不走
[GREEN]調查[WHITE] 坐落在 [LOCATION=DLC1_VALLEY_1]的建築 尋找線索

node.id: Locate the [GREEN]Thieves Hideout[WHITE] in the south.
Investigate the [LOCATION=DLC1_SOUTH_BASE] for where the valuables could be.
node.to: 調查 [LOCATION=DLC1_SOUTH_BASE] 以瞭解貴重物品可能在哪裡.

node.id: Search for treasure at [LOCATION=DLC1_SOUTH_BASE] based on clues: [ORANGE]ROAD,TARP[WHITE] and [ORANGE]UNDER[WHITE].
node.to: 尋找寶藏位於 [LOCATION=DLC1_SOUTH_BASE] 基於線索: [ORANGE]路,陷阱[WHITE] 和 [ORANGE]下表面[WHITE].

node.id: Mana Chambers have many unnatural effects. The undead rise again, the once strong are now weak and their deaths reward you with generous spoils.
node.to: 神力室有許多不自然的效果。亡靈再次崛起，曾經強大的現在變得虛弱，他們的死亡會給你豐厚的戰利品.

node.id: [GREEN]Kill[WHITE] monsters inside Mana Chamber and [GREEN]Use[WHITE] it again to raise the dead back to life.
node.to: [GREEN]擊敗[WHITE] 神力室中的怪物 [GREEN]再次使用[WHITE] 它讓死者復活.

node.id: Some enemies in the [ORANGE]Underworld[WHITE] are Infused with Mana. This makes them tougher until the protective shielding is broken away.
node.to: 一些位於[ORANGE]冥界的敵人[WHITE] 被注入了神力. 這使得它們更強壯，直到防護屏障被打破.

node.id: Mana makes the infused enemies tougher and resistant to slashing weapons, but clever use of the other tools available should take care of them.
node.to: 神力能讓被注入的敵人變得更強大，並抵抗近戰武器，但巧妙地使用其他可用工具應該能解決這些問題.
使用增強型種子袋種植

node.id: Planting crops with Enhanced Seed Bag improves your harvesting speed and makes it possible to grow Mana Beads.
node.to: 用增強種子袋種植作物會提高您的收穫速度，並使其可能生長神力珠.

node.id: Plant [GREEN]Mana Seeds[WHITE] using the Enhanced Seed Bag.
node.to: 種植 [GREEN]神力種子[WHITE] 用增強型種子袋.

node.id: Destroy 4 Mana Spirits while inside an active Mana Chamber.
node.to: 在一個啟動的神力密室中摧毀4個法力之魂.

node.id: You come up to a small village that is decorated with a hodgepodge of items from seemingly different time periods.
node.to: 你來到一個小村莊，這裡裝飾著各種各樣看似不同時代的物品.

node.id: You climb down into the 'vault'. It is definitely of modern make, which does raise some big questions.
node.to: 你爬下“金庫”。它肯定是現代製造的，這確實引發了一些大問題.
定位[GREEN]寶物[WHITE]通過[GREEN]奇怪的鑰匙[WHITE].

node.id: Find a door which accepts the [GREEN]Green Keycard[WHITE].

node.id: Fast travel between campfires have been fully unlocked. Find any link tower and install a Campfire Triangulation transmitter.
node.to: 營火之間的快速旅行已經完全解鎖。找到任何連接塔，安裝一個篝火三角定位發射器.

node.id: Campfires in this link tower area can now be used for fast travel.
node.to: 在這個連接塔區域的營火現在可以用於快速旅行.

node.to: [ORANGE]用營火[WHITE][GREEN]快速旅行到[WHITE]其他營火.

node.id: Inhabiting the plains of the Underworld, the ghostly Mana Spirit can only be made vulnerable with special mana weapons and chambers.
node.to: 居住在冥界平原的幽靈神力之魂只能通過特殊的神力武器和密室才能變得脆弱.

node.id: Powerful ranged weapon for clearing things from afar.
node.to: 強大的遠程武器，用來清除遠處的敵人.

node.id: A tiny cup that protects from being pricked or poked by spiky enemies and obstacles.
node.to: 保護自己不被尖刺敵人或障礙物刺到的小杯子.

node.id: Enables using Home Portal outside the main island.
node.to: 允許在主島之外使用家園傳送器.

node.id: A small set of internal walls to help divide your home into rooms.
node.to: 一組小的內牆，幫助劃分房間.

node.id: What are these [GREEN]Link Towers[WHITE] doing here? [EMOJI=thinking face]
node.to: 這些[GREEN]鏈塔[WHITE] 在這裡做什麼? [EMOJI=thinking face]

node.id: Is it some kind of an old antenna? It's radiating energy! [EMOJI=drooling face]
node.to: 這是什麼舊天線嗎?它有輻射能量! [EMOJI=drooling face]

node.id: It's some kind of an old antenna? It's radiating energy! [EMOJI=drooling face]
node.to: 這是什麼舊天線嗎?它有輻射能量! [EMOJI=drooling face]

node.id: Locked! There is a thin slot at the base of the hatch which could fit a [GREEN]card of some sort[WHITE]
node.to: 鎖上了!在艙口的底部有一個很薄的槽，可以放一張[GREEN]卡之類的東西[WHITE]
我的旅行問題還在繼續. [EMOJI=frowning face]
什麼?發生了什麼事? [EMOJI=worried face]

node.id: A huge sinkhole, but what is that at the bottom?
node.to: 一個巨大的天坑，但底部是什麼?

node.id: This must be the red house around which I can find the [GREEN]strange key[WHITE]!
node.to: 這一定是紅色的房子，在它周圍我可以找到 [GREEN]奇怪的鑰匙[WHITE]!

node.id: The scavenged table of chemical elements contains some previously unknown and peculiar substances.
node.to: 化學元素表中含有一些未知的特殊物質.

node.id: ''Oh my. All this commotion and strangeness. Well i do have my needlepoint hobby to keep my spirits up.''
node.to: ''哦,天哪.所有這些騷動和陌生。好吧，我的刺繡愛好可以讓我振作起來.''

node.id: The [ORANGE]vault[WHITE] continues to provide. This soft drink dispenser is truly a marvel of engineering! The drink ain't half bad either.
node.to: [ORANGE]保險庫[WHITE]繼續提供. 這個飲料自動售貨機真是工程上的一個奇跡!這酒也不錯.

node.id: As a safeguard, deposit the [GREEN]strange key[WHITE] in a stash behind the red house overlooking the windmill.
node.to: 為了安全起見，把[GREEN]奇怪的鑰匙[WHITE]藏在可以俯瞰風車的紅房子後面.

node.id: While it seems apparent that these devices are powered by electricity, they are far too sophisticated. They seem like they were manufactured after our time...
node.to: 雖然這些設備顯然是由電力驅動的，但它們太複雜了。它們似乎是在我們的時代之後製造出來的...

node.id: It's a whole town! Or at least a very big chunk of one. [EMOJI=exploding head]
node.to: 這是一個小鎮!或者至少是其中的一大塊. [EMOJI=exploding head]

node.id: At first this place felt like a dream and I thought I would soon wake up back home in [ORANGE]Sunburn Desert[WHITE]. Perhaps that distant home was itself a dream?
node.to: 一開始，這個地方感覺就像一個夢，我想我很快就會在[ORANGE]曬傷沙漠的家中醒來[WHITE]. 也許那個遙遠的家本身就是一個夢?

node.id: Ever since the stairs broke down I've had to live on a diet of eggs. Luckily, the local birds seem to prefer this cliff as a nesting site.
node.to: 自從樓梯壞了以後，我只好以吃雞蛋為生。幸運的是，當地的鳥類似乎更喜歡在這片懸崖上築巢.

node.id: The board contains different dates combined with scouting reports. There was a lookout here.
node.to: 上面有不同的日期和偵察報告。這裡有個瞭望台.

node.id: There's the campfire. Can't be that far now. [EMOJI=compass]
node.to: 那有個篝火.不會很遠吧. [EMOJI=compass]

node.id: ''The nicked Crown Tower works well enough as a test bench. I hope they don't come looking for them.''
node.to: ''有裂縫的皇冠塔作為一個測試台已經足夠好了。我希望他們不會來找它們.''

node.id: ''Here are the requested materials. Now would you be so kind and do the repairs in haste. The alternate route is vexing.
node.to: ''這是您要的材料。現在你能不能行行好，趕緊修理一下。備用線路真的很煩人.

node.id: It's a whole town! Or at least very big chunk of it. [EMOJI=exploding head]
node.to: 這是一個小鎮!或者至少是很大一部分. [EMOJI=exploding head]

node.id: ''There still has been nothing whatsoever happening at the tower. I am shocked as always.''
node.to: ''塔上仍然沒有發生任何事情。我一如既往地感到震驚.''

node.id: How did they get the rock on top of this?
node.to: 他們是怎麼把石頭弄到這上面的？

node.id: ''More and more thieves are sneaking around these days. I wonder if troubles in the town are getting worse.''
node.to: ''這些天越來越多的小偷偷偷摸摸的.我不知道鎮上的問題是否越來越嚴重了.''

node.id: Someone had a really bad day.
That sparkling jolt of electricity feels strange to touch, like my heartbeats suddenly grew slower.
node.to: 那種閃閃發光的電流觸碰起來感覺很奇怪，就像我的心跳突然變慢了.

node.id: I should have believed you when you said to sell my suit and tie and to come and live with you. Instead I ended up in another world or something.
node.to: 當你說要賣掉我的西裝和領帶，搬來和你一起住的時候，我就應該相信你的。結果我卻來到了另一個世界.

node.id: ''Those darn thieves took my precious! They must have taken it to their hideout in the south. I'm never getting it back.''
node.to: ''那些該死的小偷偷走了我的寶貝!他們一定是把它帶到南邊的藏身處了。我再也拿不回來了.''

node.id: Maybe I should take a look. I hope it's not too far away.
node.to: 也許我應該看一下。我希望不會太遠.

node.id: ''Connecting the door with the tower was trivial.''
node.to: ''把門和塔連接起來並不重要.''

node.id: There's something familiar here at least. Looks strange though. [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]
node.to: 至少這裡有些熟悉的東西.雖然看起來奇怪. [EMOJI=face with raised eyebrow]

node.id: I should go to see what's so special about those towers.
node.to: 我應該去看看那些塔有什麼特別之處.

node.id: I should go to check that signal at some point.
node.to: 我該找個時間去看看那個信號.

node.id: ''This crown tower requires some kind of tool to operate beyond basic functions. No luck in cracking it so far.''
node.to: ''這個皇冠塔需要某種工具來完成基本功能之外的操作。目前還沒找到.''

node.id: ''Note to self. Get materials for fixing the roof.''
''Isn't assembling this energy whatchamacallit a bit early? The building isn't even ready yet.''
node.to: ''集結這股能量是不是有點早了?大樓還沒準備好呢.''

node.id: There's a note here that says [ORANGE]TARP[WHITE]
node.to: 這裡有張紙條上寫著 [ORANGE]陷阱[WHITE]

node.id: Some scoundrels had a meeting here.
''Boss hides the treasure and gives us [ORANGE]three clues[WHITE] for the location. Check. Hide your clue in a house shown on the board. Check. Get rid of the evidence. On it.''
node.to: ''Boss藏起了寶藏，並給了我們[ORANGE]三條線索[WHITE].把你的線索藏在黑板上的房子裡.銷毀證據.沒問題.''

node.id: Looks simple enough. I should check these places for those clues.
node.to: 看起來很簡單。我應該去這些地方看看有沒有線索.

node.id: ''Hide your clues in these locations. And remember, don't tell anyone or else!''
node.to: ''把你的線索藏在這些地方.記住.不要告訴任何人或其他人!''

node.id: ''Everyone should learn to organize their plunderage better. We are civilized people here!''
node.to: ''每個人都應該學會更好地組織自己的行為。我們是文明人!''

node.id: Lorne's booty and business. Bargaining for your life has never been easier.
node.to: 洛恩的戰利品和生意。為你的生活討價還價從來沒有這麼容易過.

node.id: I found it! Hidden in plain sight. [EMOJI=victory hand]
node.to: 我找到它了!隱藏在顯而易見的地方. [EMOJI=victory hand]

node.id: ''Getting a little tight in this joint. More fools are taking the easy road and trying to live off theft. Their loss.''
node.to: ''這裡有的生活有些困難了.更多的傻瓜選擇了簡單的道路,試圖以偷竊為生.這是他們的損失.''

node.id: There's a note here that says [ORANGE]ROAD[WHITE]
node.to: 這裡有張紙條上寫著 [ORANGE]道路[WHITE]

node.id: How could anyone live here? [EMOJI=flushed face]
node.to: 怎麼會有人住在這裡? [EMOJI=flushed face]

node.id: This isn't a vault but a shelter from modern day!
node.to: 這不是保險庫，而是現代避難所!

node.id: Location unknown, no contact with the base back at the [ORANGE]Three Sisters[WHITE]. My only theory is that overcharging the [GREEN]Blue Eye Orb[WHITE] must have caused some sort of quantum event.
node.to: 位置未知,與 [ORANGE]Three Sisters[WHITE]沒有聯繫. 我唯一的理論是過度充電 [GREEN]藍眼球[WHITE] 一定引起了某種量子事件.

node.id: The sad reality is that we aren't probably going to get back home. We need to try to adapt and expand the existing shelter.
node.to: 可悲的現實是，我們可能回不了家了。我們需要嘗試適應和擴大現有的避難所.

node.id: Do not venture outside alone! Always group up as it is a hostile environment up there.
node.to: 不要獨自外出冒險!一定要組隊，因為那裡的環境很惡劣.

node.id: [AMOUNT] XP already gained from this quest.
node.to: [AMOUNT] 經驗已經從這個探索中獲得.

node.id: The flame looks different. Pretty colors. [EMOJI=fire]

node.to: 警告\n需要授權\n私有財產

node.id: Ivory Mountain Research Laboratory\nNo unauthorized personel\nbeyond this point
node.to: 象牙山研究實驗室\n沒有授權的人員\n除了這一點
歡迎來到皇冠鎮\n建立於1885

node.id: But where did I go this time?
I should look around. Maybe this place can give some answers.
node.to: 我應該四處看看。也許這個地方能給我們一些答案.

node.id: It's closed. Maybe a [ORANGE]Link Tower[WHITE] can help with this door too [EMOJI=index pointing up]
node.to: 他關閉了. 可能[ORANGE]鏈塔[WHITE]可以幫助我們打開這道門 [EMOJI=index pointing up]

node.id: ''Connecting the automatic door with the [ORANGE]Link Tower[WHITE] was trivial.''
node.to: ''正在通過[ORANGE]鏈塔連接自動門[WHITE] 不費吹灰之力.''

node.to: 用兩個手指滑動來移動相機
